title: Bird’s-eye View of the Performance Annex at the City Heights Library Under Construction
description:
Get a bird’s-eye view of the Performance Annex at the City Heights Library under construction.🎭

Expected to open this summer, this theater will provide a bigger and better space for dance and music classes, live performances and more!

We can’t wait to show this city’s talent. 🎟️
#CityHeights #SanDiego #Library
